summary: Santander UK plc filed a Form 6-K announcing four new appointments to its Executive Committee, including a new CFO (Tom Ranger, effective 1 October 2026, subject to regulatory approval) replacing Angel Santodomingo, who resigns as Executive Director effective 31 October 2026 and moves to Banco Santander in January 2027. Steve Affleck becomes Chief Accounting Officer, Michael Christodoulides Chief Compliance Officer (from 1 November 2026, subject to approval), and Iñaki Perkins Head of Cards Payments. The changes align structure with Banco Santander and support TSB integration. No price, premium, or deal terms stated. Watch for regulatory approvals and CFO transition impact.
